model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the "effect" values across multiple language family categories for six different model configurations. The horizontal axis displays language family categories arranged from left to right: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic family, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis is labeled "effect" and uses a linear scale ranging from approximately 0 to 30, with tick marks at intervals of 10. For each language family category, six bars are grouped together, representing six model variants as indicated in the legend: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (light green), mBERT-R₂ (light pink/salmon), XLM-R₂ (red), mBERT-B₂ (dark blue), and XLM-B₂ (dark red). Each bar includes error bars indicating variability or confidence intervals. Most bars across the categories appear to have values near or slightly below 0, with some notable exceptions: the IE-Romance category shows some of the tallest bars, particularly for the red-toned variants (XLM-R₂ and mBERT-B₂), which appear to reach values around -5 to -10 in the negative direction. The IE-Indic category also displays relatively prominent bars, especially for the green (XLM-L₂) and red variants. The Isolate and Semitic categories show relatively small bar heights close to zero. The Uralic category displays moderate bar heights with notably large error bars, particularly for XLM-B₂. The IE-Baltic category shows uniformly small bars near zero. Error bars vary considerably across categories, with some extending substantially, suggesting high uncertainty in certain estimates. The bars do not appear to be sorted by value but rather follow a categorical ordering of language families, and the chart is rendered in a three-dimensional perspective view, which gives the bars a receding appearance from left to right.
